meta.purpose: Independently finalises one staged, complete GDELT H1 context record.

nodes.name: Schedule staged-hour import
nodes.notes: Reads only completed staging records; no implicit retry or backfill.

nodes.name: Import one complete staged hour

parameters.query: WITH candidate AS (SELECT * FROM forex.gdelt_hourly_stage WHERE imported_at_utc IS NULL AND jsonb_array_length(source_records)=4 ORDER BY bucket_time_utc LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED), hourly AS (INSERT INTO forex.raw_observation (observation_id, contract_version, source_id, source_revision, observed_at_utc, available_at_utc, retrieved_at_utc, timezone, payload_sha256, payload_path, redacted) SELECT stage_id, 'forex.gdelt-context.v1', 'gdelt-sentiment-prototype', bucket_time_utc::text || '-4x15m', bucket_time_utc, bucket_time_utc + interval '1 hour', retrieved_at_utc, 'UTC', aggregate_sha256, 'n8n://gdelt/h1/' || bucket_time_utc::text, true FROM candidate ON CONFLICT (observation_id) DO NOTHING), aggregate AS (INSERT INTO forex.gdelt_h1_aggregate (aggregate_id, observation_id, bucket_time_utc, available_at_utc, article_count, mean_tone, query_definition_version, uncertainty_label) SELECT stage_id, stage_id, bucket_time_utc, bucket_time_utc + interval '1 hour', article_count, mean_tone, query_definition_version, uncertainty_label FROM candidate ON CONFLICT (observation_id, bucket_time_utc) DO NOTHING RETURNING observation_id) UPDATE forex.gdelt_hourly_stage stage SET imported_at_utc=now() FROM candidate WHERE stage.stage_id=candidate.stage_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aggregate) RETURNING stage.stage_id, stage.bucket_time_utc;

nodes.notes: Fixed import only; it cannot receive SQL, URL, host, or trading inputs.
